name: Bruna Guerin
bio: Bruna Guerin (São Paulo, August 10, 1985), is a Brazilian actress, singer, dancer and voice actress.

credits.title: Pecadora
credits.overview: Isabel is a very religious young woman whose life is transformed when she starts working with Enrico, a free-spirited and seductive man. As she tries to deny her attraction to her colleague and the awakening of her most forbidden desires, she finds herself confronting everything she always believed.

credits.title: Zuzubaland: The Movie
credits.overview: An enchanted kingdom where everything is made of food. Next to this magical place lives a Witch who doesn't like to eat. Disguised as a Web Influencer, she convinces the bees to stop pollinating and pursue professions such as YouTubers, eyebrow designers, yoga teachers and others.

credits.title: Flow
credits.overview: First volume of a trilogy about anguish. A political-marital dystopia that follows a couple in crisis. Carla kicks Rodrigo out of the house, but he can't leave the apartment because of a lockdown imposed by the authorities. credits.title: Meu Álbum de Amores
credits.overview: Julio is a peaceful, uptight dentist who planned his life 80 years in advance. Suddenly dumped by his girlfriend, he also finds out he is the son of a womanizer, a popular singer of the 1970s, and the brother of an intense gay musician, both of whom he never knew—until now.

credits.title: Insta-Lie
credits.overview: An actor in search of fame finds on his Instagram the way to gain likes and boost his career. To maintain his fake life online, he does crazy things in real life and risks losing track of who he really is.

credits.title: The Under-Undergrounds, the Beginning
credits.overview: When a rejected guitar player falls into a manhole, he meets a welcoming group of misfit musicians who try to help him find his way back home.

credits.title: Polyamory
credits.overview: In a society where monogamous affective values predominate, some people opt for a relationship arrangement that is becoming known as polyamory.
